role: Real, mechanical patch proposal for R-18's findings — a method callable without a real enforcePermission() call. Inserts the exact real call as the first statement of the method body. Deliberately narrow: one specific, verifiable insertion, not general AST-based code repair.
behaviorDescription: proposePatches() inserts a real enforcePermission() call, verified against a real missing-check case and a real already-has-check case (correctly skipped, not double-patched) before implementation.
hardStops: Never re-patches a method that already has a real enforcePermission() call
Never applies a patch directly to a real file — proposes the patched text only
